principles: All frames and labels from one episode remain in exactly one split.
Scenario variants generated from the same base scenario are grouped before assignment.
Human replays from one participant pair remain in one split.
No hidden intent plan is exposed as model input.

tracks.train_condition: script and policy families assigned to training
tracks.test_condition: unseen policy implementations for known intents

tracks.train_condition: truth may be used only for targets
tracks.test_condition: inputs are restricted to red or blue partial observations
tracks.purpose: operational intent inference under fog of war

release_rule: Publish train and validation labels. Keep final test labels in a separate evaluation package when hosting a leaderboard.
